_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in what you want. EVERYTHING here is optional - the digest runs with zero config. Add a TMDB key to see India OTT availability; add Telegram to get the digest pushed to your phone.
_tmdb_help: Get a FREE key at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api (create account -> API -> Developer). Paste the v4 'API Read Access Token' into tmdb_bearer, OR the v3 'API Key' into tmdb_api_key. Either works; bearer is preferred.
_telegram_help: Optional push-to-phone. In Telegram, message @BotFather -> /newbot to get a token. Then message @userinfobot to get your numeric chat id. Paste both here and the digest is sent to you every run.
_tuning_help: rating_threshold = the weighted-rating bar (Gate 2). recent_years = how far back the weekly digest looks. pool_floor/pool_cap size the weekly digest's TMDB candidate pool. browse_vote_floor/browse_cap size the all-time browse catalog (lower floor / higher cap = more films but slower first build). browse_workers = concurrent TMDB lookups.
